They imagined a friend inside your computer.

THE FUTURE HAD A FEATHERED FRIEND.

Some ideas arrive
a little too early.

In the 1990s, researchers imagined computers you could simply talk to. One of those dreams took the form of a parrot.

Peedy is our independent love letter to that idea: a friendly presence with a personality, a memory, and a reason to come back.

1993

The original dream

Microsoft Research’s Persona project explored animated conversational interfaces. Peedy the Parrot could help people choose music and ask follow-up questions.

Watch the original research ↗
1997 → 2009

A familiar face on the desktop

Microsoft Agent brought programmable characters and speech to applications. Microsoft later discontinued the platform with Windows 7.

Read the original announcement ↗
NOW

A familiar character. A new chapter.

A conversational music player: search your library, ask for an artist or mood, and control playback by voice or text. An optional local language model adds open-ended conversation. This is a community interpretation, not restored Microsoft software.

A COMMUNITY WITH A LITTLE CHARACTER.

Come for the bird.
Stay for the revival.

A forgotten-future companion,
with a community building its next chapter.

$PEEDY is the working identity for our memecoin community concept. Peedy is free to meet. Holding a token is not required to use the companion.

A BRAIN OF HIS OWN

Wake up Peedy’s AI.

Download a small language model and chat directly on your device. No account, API key, or token required.

One-time downloadAbout 1 GB. The model is cached by your browser.

Runs on your computerRequires WebGPU and available graphics memory. Desktop Chrome or Edge is recommended.

Your chat stays hereText generation happens locally. Voice requests may use your browser’s speech service and are sent to Peedy automatically.

Local AI can make mistakes. Peedy controls this music player and the audio files you choose to add. He cannot access your screen, wallet, or other apps.

Preparing…

Llama 3.2 1B via WebLLM. Music requests work without the model. Other offline replies are written responses.
